landing.title: We move your business forward
landing.subtitle: A course, advice and a sales plan — made for you
landing.gateLead: A course and sales plan for this case. The panel opens only after log in or sign up.
landing.gateHasHint: You already have a shop or service — a short form.
landing.gateStartHint: You have not started yet — budget and skills.
landing.gateNeedAuth: Before the panel, log in or create an account so nothing is lost.
landing.useLead: Sales, course, shop window and advice — no fake CRM.
landing.use1d: Six lessons with a test. Progress from your work, not demo numbers.
landing.use2d: What you sold this week and what to do tomorrow — from your form.
landing.use3d: Paste a shop link. We read public goods and reviews.
landing.use4d: You write a question. The answer has steps, not a profit promise.
landing.what3: A course and a sales plan open
landing.howLead: First the form. Then login or sign up before the panel. Then the course and sales plan.
landing.s1d: Product, city, volume, price and, if you have one, the shop link. Or budget and skills if you are just starting.
landing.s2d: An account is needed before the panel. The form is kept.
landing.s3d: Four suggestions, one path, six lessons and a sales plan. A forecast, not a profit promise.
landing.f1d: Catalog, sales CSV, cash register. No marketplace scraping.
landing.f2d: Capacity, season, competitor price and promo — manual or CSV.
landing.f3d: True cost, shelf price, elasticity, “why this price”.
landing.f4d: What-if and crash test before a major decision.
landing.m1: AI agents: CEO, CFO, sales, inventory, risk
landing.m2: Stress tests: sales, costs, FX, supply
landing.m3: Decision steps: analyze → explain → simulate → recommend → learn
landing.honestLead: You write. AI analyses. The answer is a forecast, not a profit promise.
landing.is1: It reads the form and the public shop — goods and reviews from the site, not invented numbers.
landing.is2: It opens a six-lesson course and a sales plan.
landing.is3: Advice in your language: Tajik, Russian or English.
landing.is4: Open numbers come from the public shop or from what you typed — not from a locked cabinet.
landing.not1: It does not log into a seller cabinet or Instagram Insights. It does not invent hidden sales.
landing.not2: It does not log into someone else’s site admin.
landing.not3: It does not scrape Somon/OLX prices.
landing.bentoTitle: Five pillars, wired to each other
landing.agentsTitle: Seven agents, one source of numbers
landing.agentsBody: Every agent reads the same business data, so the answers do not contradict each other.
landing.pipeTitle: From a number to a decision — five steps
landing.pipeLead: This is not a chatbot. Each step consumes the output of the one before it.
landing.p1d: Reads your catalog, cash register and sales CSV. Computes Health, margin and cash-flow.
landing.p2d: Says why the number looks like that: season, thin margin, dead stock or a competitor price.
landing.p3d: Before recommending, the proposed step is run on the twin — revenue, profit, cash-flow.
landing.p4d: One concrete action lands in the Action Center with an estimated TJS-per-month impact.
landing.p5d: The decision and its result stay in business memory and shape later recommendations.
landing.priceHead: Pricing is public. No sales call required.
landing.q1q: I do not have a business yet. Is this for me?
landing.q1a: Yes. On the first step choose “No, I want to start one” — enter your budget and direction and get 3 realistic options with buy price, sell price, profit and risk.
landing.q2q: Does it pull prices from Somon or OLX?
landing.q2a: No, and that is deliberate. You enter competitor prices manually or via CSV, which makes the comparison real instead of invented.
landing.q3q: How accurate are the forecast numbers?
landing.q3a: They depend on the quality of your data. The system shows a data-completeness percentage. Profit is never guaranteed.
landing.q4q: Does the AI act on my behalf?
landing.q4a: No. The AI builds a recommendation and puts it in the Action Center. Execution happens only after you approve it.
landing.q5q: Does it work without internet or without an AI key?
landing.q5a: The core computation runs on the system’s own server. Without a Claude key the local model takes over, and the screen says so.
landing.ctaBody: Sign-up is short. Then stock, then the till, then the panel. No pretty numbers in advance.
landing.footerNote: Advice is a forecast, not a promise of profit.
landing.faq1q: Do I need an account before the form?
landing.faq1a: No. You fill the form first. Login or sign up is asked before the panel.
landing.faq2a: No. Advice and the plan are a forecast. The decision and the risk stay with the owner.
landing.faq3a: In PostgreSQL if the database is connected. Otherwise data can vanish after the server sleeps — a banner will warn you.
landing.trial: Numbers come from what you write. Profit is not promised.

pilotCourse.m1d: What it means to be an owner
pilotCourse.m1c:
An owner solves a problem and is paid for it.
Find the buyer first, then the goods. Goods + buyer + price = a sale.
pilotCourse.m2c: Profit = income minus cost. Anything that leaves is a cost. Many lose because they do not count costs.
pilotCourse.m3c: Marketing is not TV ads. The right people see your goods. Friends, Telegram, the bazaar, word of mouth.
pilotCourse.m4c: Price = cost + the profit you need, then check the market. Too cheap looks like low quality.
pilotCourse.m5c: A new buyer is about 5 times more expensive than keeping an old one. Keep quality and promises.
pilotCourse.m6c: First become stable, then grow, then expand. Do not grow before the current step works.
pilotCourse.m1a: For {product}: write down 10 possible buyers in {region}. A list of names beats a bigger volume.
pilotCourse.m2a: Your numbers: {volume} × {price} TJS ≈ {revenue} TJS a month. Subtract your costs — what is left is the real profit.
pilotCourse.m3a: In {region} post one photo of {product} with a price every day. Seven photos a week is already a channel.
pilotCourse.m4a: Your price today is {price} TJS. Write the cost per unit; if the gap is tiny, the price is too low.
pilotCourse.m5a: Write 5 repeat buyers of {product} with their phone number. One message a week is cheaper than finding someone new.
pilotCourse.m6a: Take the next step only when {volume} sells steadily. Then try more volume or a new channel in {region}.
